cohort: The study participants were women with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) in pregnancy who were part of the metformin in women with type 2 diabetes in pregnancy (MiTy) trial data.
finding: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) in women with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) during pregnancy was associated with increased maternal complications like excess weight gain and insulin requirements, but not neonatal complications, and metformin's efficacy varied by PCOS status.
